categories.main_business_segments: Hailun Piano Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, manufacturing, sales, and service of pianos and related musical instruments, including traditional pianos, smart electric pianos, and accessories. The company also operates in the cultural sector through art education and training services. Its product portfolio includes upright pianos, grand pianos, digital pianos, and other small musical instruments, alongside art education programs and competitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates advanced technologies such as CAD/CAM, 3D animation, digital simulation, and computer-aided manufacturing in piano design and production. It employs a standardized, series-based, and formalized management approach, combining modern high-tech with traditional piano craftsmanship. Hailun has developed proprietary technologies including a patented positioning hole interlocking process for streamlined production and uses innovative materials like cast aluminum alloy plates and synthetic ebony keys. The company also invests in smart instrument development, including intelligent pianos and digital musical instruments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hailun serves domestic and international customers, including distributors and end consumers primarily in large and medium-sized cities. Its markets cover both offline and online sales channels, with significant presence in China and export markets in Europe, America, and the Asia-Pacific region. The company also collaborates with music schools, art institutions, and educational organizations to promote music education and piano usage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It also has sales and distribution networks covering major regions within China, including East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northeast, Southwest, and Northwest. Internationally, Hailun exports to Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hailun operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the piano industry supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, assembly, and direct sales of finished pianos and musical instruments. It also engages in downstream activities such as retail, distribution, and music education services, including art training and cultural promotion.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and product upgrading, focusing on smart piano development and intelligent manufacturing. It invests significantly in R&D to enhance product performance and diversify offerings, including smart electric pianos and other intelligent musical instruments. Hailun also prioritizes expanding sales channels through e-commerce and live streaming, strengthening brand building, and deepening collaborations with music institutions to foster market growth.
categories.revenue_model: Hailun generates revenue mainly through the sale of musical instruments, including traditional and smart pianos, accessories, and related products. It also earns income from art education and training services. Sales occur via both offline distributors and online platforms such as Tmall and Douyin, supplemented by promotional activities and bidding projects. Additional revenue streams include government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hailun is a leading domestic piano manufacturer in China, recognized as a national cultural industry demonstration base and a key player in the musical instrument industry. It competes with both domestic and international piano brands, including German Bechstein and Czech Petrof, with whom it also cooperates as an ODM partner. The company holds a strong brand reputation domestically and internationally, supported by numerous awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hailun reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 159.2 million, a 46.47% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 97.9 million, worsening by 24.18%. The company experienced a significant decline in piano sales volume and production, with increased unit production costs and reduced gross margins. Despite the downturn, the company maintains substantial total assets exceeding RMB 1.1 billion and continues investing in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hailun differentiates itself through a combination of high-quality traditional piano craftsmanship and cutting-edge smart technology integration. It offers a diversified product range with enhanced performance, intelligent features, and customization options. The company leverages advanced manufacturing processes, patented technologies, and strong brand recognition to provide reliable, innovative musical instruments and comprehensive music education services, aiming to meet evolving consumer demands and foster cultural engagement.
